# The GURT recipe

Cookie's recipe for [GURT](https://github.com/clrealy/GURT), which installs
any distro's packages on any distro.

These two files belong in the GURT repository, at `packages/cookie/`:

```sh
mkdir -p ../GURT/packages/cookie
cp GURTBUILD .gurtinfo ../GURT/packages/cookie/
cd ../GURT && ./tools/lint.sh
```

They live here as well so the recipe is versioned alongside what it builds.

## What it does

| | |
|---|---|
| Builds | `cargo build --release --locked` from a pinned commit |
| Build deps | `rust`, `git` — nothing else; Cookie compiles no C |
| Runtime deps | **none declared**, deliberately — see below |
| Installs | the binary, the `.desktop` handler, the `.cpk` MIME definition, both icon sizes, the licence and the docs |

### Why Waydroid is not a declared dependency

Cookie needs Waydroid to actually run an app, but it is not in `depends=()`.

Waydroid is missing from several distributions' official repositories, so a
hard dependency would make Cookie uninstallable on them. Cookie is useful
without it — `bake`, `jar`, `burnt` and `kitchen` all work — and the moment it
is needed, `cookie burnt` names the right package for the distribution you are
on. The same goes for `lxc`, which only the `oven` backend uses.

This also matches the repository's own habit: 13 of its 2731 recipes declare
runtime dependencies at all.

If `waydroid` and `lxc` are ever added to GURT's `deps.map`, promoting them to
`depends=(waydroid)` and an optional note is a one-line change.

### Repointing it

Use the script, not an editor:

```sh
dist/gurt/repoint.sh          # pins HEAD
dist/gurt/repoint.sh <commit> # or a specific one
```

It moves the pinned commit **and** bumps `pkgrel`, because those two have to
move together. gurt decides whether a package is outdated by comparing
`pkgver-pkgrel`, so changing the commit alone produces a recipe that builds
something new while every installed copy is told it is already up to date.
That happened three times before the script existed.

It also keeps the commit in the `source=` pin and the one in the `icon=` URL
in step; a recipe with those out of sync builds the right code and shows a
404 for its icon. A test in `tests/dist_files.rs` fails if they ever drift.

### Keeping it current

The recipe pins a commit rather than a tag, because Cookie has no release tag
yet. Once it has one, replace the `#commit=` fragment with `#tag=` and set
`pkgver` to match — that is the whole change.

`.gurtinfo` is regenerated by GURT's CI after merge, so a stale one is only a
warning from the linter, never an error.
